name: Mango Lassi
description: A creamy and refreshing mango yogurt drink, a Pakistani classic.
instructions: Blend mango puree, yogurt, and sugar until smooth.
Add ice cubes, serve chilled.

name: Sugarcane Juice
description: Freshly extracted sugarcane juice with a hint of lemon.
instructions: Extract juice from sugarcane using a juicer.
Mix with lemon juice, add ice and water, serve fresh.

name: Pomegranate Juice
instructions: Blend pomegranate seeds, strain the juice.
Add sugar and water, serve with ice.

name: Orange Juice
description: Freshly squeezed orange juice with a zesty flavor.
instructions: Squeeze juice from oranges.
Mix with honey, serve with ice.

name: Guava Juice
description: A sweet and tropical guava drink.
instructions: Blend guavas with sugar and water, strain.
Serve with ice.

name: Watermelon Juice
description: A hydrating and sweet summer juice.
instructions: Blend watermelon, add lemon juice.
Serve with ice.

name: Banana Shake
description: A creamy banana juice with milk.
instructions: Blend bananas, milk, and sugar.
Add ice, serve chilled.

name: Mixed Fruit Juice
instructions: Blend all fruits with sugar and water.
Strain if desired, serve cold.

name: Carrot Juice
description: A nutritious juice with a hint of ginger.
instructions: Blend carrots and ginger with water.
Add honey, serve fresh.

name: Pineapple Juice
description: A tangy and sweet pineapple drink.
instructions: Blend pineapple with sugar and water.
Serve with ice.
